model_source: novendor_1.telemetry.tel_rul_regressor version 1 (run c970fdcc; GBM, RMSE 20.32 / PHM 1423; frozen inference, no retrain)

blocker.summary: Gate 0 as designed (score ALL FD001 test cycles, compute per-window absolute RUL error) is not executable: the C-MAPSS test set has no per-cycle RUL truth.
blocker.evidence: gold_cmapss_features FD001 split=test: 13096 rows, 0 non-null rul_target (100% NaN). split=train: 20631 rows, 20631 non-null. Per-unit test truth lives only in silver_cmapss_rul (100 units, one RUL each, at the last observed cycle).
blocker.root_cause: By dataset construction, C-MAPSS test units are truncated and only a single final-cycle RUL is published per unit. gold_cmapss_features.rul_target is therefore populated for train rows and NaN for every test row. The shipped train_rul.py handles this by evaluating one row per unit (last cycle) merged from silver_cmapss_rul.
blocker.consequence: There is no per-cycle absolute error to correlate against embedding distance. The all-cycle within-band design (13096 windows) cannot be computed. The only valid test target is last-cycle-per-unit (100 windows), which is a DIFFERENT experiment (changes within-band density and the A/B-pair premise).
blocker.decision: STOP at blocker receipt. Per the ticket's attempt rule, four runs were spent, the failing cause is now a method-relevant data fact (not environmental), and restructuring to last-cycle-per-unit would be patching into a different experiment. The restructure is a next-ticket decision, not a fifth patch.

verdict_note: No continue / train_contrastive / kill verdict is produced. The gate never reached its statistics under a valid target. Do not infer a result.

environment_reproducibility.why: REQUIRED. The tel_rul_regressor champion was pickled under scikit-learn 1.4.2 (dispatch 0003 Phase 2). Newer sklearn removes GradientBoostingRegressor's HalfSquaredError.get_init_raw_predictions; predict() then raises AttributeError. Any future run loading this champion MUST pin scikit-learn==1.4.2.
environment_reproducibility.serverless_job_spec: runs/submit with environment_key 'Default' + environments[].spec {client:'2', dependencies:['mlflow','scikit-learn==1.4.2']}. A bare serverless task has no mlflow/sklearn.
environment_reproducibility.cli_auth: Databricks CLI v1.0.0 rejects the cached PAT; set DATABRICKS_AUTH_TYPE=pat and DATABRICKS_CONFIG_FILE=/dev/null. For SQL use curl against /api/2.0/sql/statements (warehouse 0e56420fb707d861); `databricks api post` returns Not Found in v1.0.0.

caveats: No verdict was produced. The Trust Layer thesis is neither validated nor killed by this run.
all_cycle scoring was the intended density move but is invalid for C-MAPSS test (no per-cycle truth).
The shipped 20.32 RMSE is the last-cycle-per-unit benchmark and was never recomputed here; do not cite this session as competitive or non-competitive.
FD001 is single-fault-mode; the novel-fault-mode (FD003 cross-subset) novelty test is a later step regardless.
recommended_next_ticket: Redesign Gate 0 to the last-cycle-per-unit target (100 FD001 test units, truth merged from silver_cmapss_rul, same as train_rul.py). Re-evaluate whether the within-band distance/error question is answerable at n=100, or whether train-set cross-validation (where per-cycle truth EXISTS) is the better falsification surface. This is a method decision for the next session, not a patch.
